name: date-field
title: Date field
description: A typed date (or date and time) in the locale's order, with min/max and month-day mode.

when: Typing a known date: a birthday, an expiry date.

instead.when: People need to see a calendar.

builtIn: Required fields show "Fill in this field."; a partly typed date says what is missing.

genui.description: A typed date. Use date-picker when a calendar helps. Emits change.
